aPropos.dedicaceDebut: This app is dedicated to the memory of
aPropos.dedicaceFin: A dua for them, and may peace be upon you.
aPropos.texte: Sama Jàmm is a free app, without ads, to read, listen, pray and keep the household budget.
aPropos.sourceCoran: Quran text: Uthmani edition obtained through alquran.cloud (api.alquran.cloud), reproduced without modification.
aPropos.sourceAdhan: Calls to prayer: two recordings (Fajr, then Dhuhr to Isha), free, provided for Sama Jàmm.
aPropos.polices: Fonts: Cormorant Garamond, Source Serif 4, Source Sans 3, Amiri, Amiri Quran, Noto Sans Arabic (SIL Open Font License). Icons: Lucide (ISC license).
aPropos.signalerAide: Shares the list of the latest errors: codes and versions, never your data
aPropos.sourceTanzil: Transliteration, juz, hizb and prostrations: Tanzil Project (tanzil.net), CC BY 3.0 license, reproduced without modification.
aPropos.sourceInvocations: Supplications: UmmahAPI (ummahapi.com), with the collection and number cited for each supplication. Arabic and transliteration from the source; titles and meanings in French, written for Sama Jàmm. Quran texts stay in Arabic only.
aPropos.sourceRecitations: Recitations: alquran.cloud (Islamic Network), authorized by the reciters or their rights holders for free, non-commercial distribution.

coran.resume: Uthmani edition · Tanzil markers, CC BY 3.0

polices.resume: Cormorant, Source Serif, Source Sans, Amiri, Noto · SIL OFL · Lucide icons (ISC)

budget.premierResume_other: {{count}} envelopes · you will enter your income on your next payday.

budget.enveloppeDuCycle: Envelope for the cycle, from {{debut}} to {{fin}}.

budget.supprimerEnveloppeAvec_other: It will be deleted along with its {{count}} expenses ({{montant}}). Your totals will drop accordingly.

budget.verrouEchec: Unlocking canceled. Try again whenever you like.
budget.comptesIntro: Where the household’s money is, today.
budget.virementNote: A transfer between two accounts is neither an expense nor income: it does not touch your envelopes.
budget.chiffrementTitre: The budget cannot be opened in this version

devise.xofDetail: Senegal and the WAEMU zone · no decimals
devise.symboleErreur: The symbol is required (4 characters at most).
devise.intro: Choose the currency of your budget, or add your own.
devise.note: A budget book keeps a single currency. Changing it converts the amounts already entered with the rate you give; you can also open a new book, without conversion.
devise.tauxInvalide: Enter a positive rate, with 6 decimals at most.
devise.conversionNote: All budget amounts will be converted and rounded to the nearest unit: totals may vary very slightly.
devise.nouveauTexte: A new book in {{devise}} takes over your envelopes, at zero. Your current book stays saved on this phone, without conversion, but it is no longer shown.

etats.horsLigneEcouter: Your downloaded recitations stay available. The rest will return with the network.

etats.miseAJourTitre: A new version is waiting for you
etats.miseAJourTexte: This version can no longer calculate some prayer times correctly. The update takes less than a minute.
etats.miseAJourNote: Your budget, your favorites and your downloads are kept.
etats.otaTexte: Improvements are ready. They will also apply the next time you open the app.

accessibilite.arcDuJour: The sun’s path between the five prayers

dettes.bandeauPassee_other: Overdue for {{count}} days. A kind word can help.
dettes.annulerTexte: The debt with {{personne}} moves to the closed debts. Its history is kept.
dettes.supprimerPaiementTexte: {{type}} of {{montant}} on {{date}}. The debt will be recalculated.
dettes.depasse: This amount is more than what is left: {{montant}}
dettes.remiseTexte: The remaining {{montant}} is erased and the debt is settled.
dettes.rappelMessage: Hello {{personne}}, a friendly reminder: {{montant}} is still left of what I lent you. Thank you!

sauvegarde.voir: Back up, restore, export as CSV
sauvegarde.intro: Your budget never leaves this phone. A backup encrypted with a password lets you keep it elsewhere, or recover it on a new phone.
sauvegarde.recommencerAide: Erases the budget on this phone to create a new one
sauvegarde.recommencerTexte: All your budget data (transactions, envelopes, accounts, debts, savings, zakat) will be erased from this phone, with no way back. Make a backup first if you want to be able to recover it.
sauvegarde.recommencee: Budget erased. You can create a new one.
sauvegarde.sauvegarderAide: A password-protected file, to send wherever you like
sauvegarde.restaurerAide: Replaces the budget on this phone
sauvegarde.motDePasseAvertissement: Without this password, the backup can never be opened, even by us. Write it down somewhere safe.
sauvegarde.differents: The two passwords are not the same.
sauvegarde.restaurerAvertissement: The budget on this phone will be fully replaced by “{{fichier}}”.
sauvegarde.motDePasseIncorrect: Wrong password, or this file is not a Sama Jàmm backup.
sauvegarde.incompatible: This backup comes from a newer version of the app. Update the app, then try again.
